title: System memories absent from the searchable corpus: no index pass, no entity provider
wanted_capability: sm-* system memories retrievable through hybrid search and resolvable as graph entities. Today the SystemMemory entity type exists only in the ref grammar (bbox-corpus-core entity_ref.rs): no reindex pass writes system_memory tantivy docs (zero matches in bbox-corpus-index), no provider in bbox-mcp-tools resolves the type (zero matches in src/ and bbox-mcp-tools), describe_schema reports system_memory: 0 entities, and inspect returns an empty shell. sm-* runbooks are reachable ONLY via bbox_knowledge catalog lookup. Consequence found via eval: cross-modal-notes-side-channel expects system_memory:sm-side-channel-notes and is structurally unpassable (pass_strictness=all), same genus as the transcript-modality regression gap-edc84378.
fallback_used: bbox_knowledge catalog lookup remains the only retrieval path for sm-* content
